decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake system extends the firm's core spraying technology into a corrosion-protection niche, but it is only mentioned on the website, so its results are still uncertain; with one year on the market and no signal of a shortfall against aspirations, the low cost of carrying it on available slack favours keeping it.

The low-pressure injection pump has a page of its own, which signals that management is committed to it and sees its early results as meeting aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The material transfer pump shares components and customers with the core pump line, so it costs little to carry, and one year is too short to judge it below aspiration despite its limited visibility.
Fire protection flow monitoring is shown on a page of its own and serves a regulation-driven market with steady demand, so it is likely meeting aspirations and worth keeping while it builds up sales.
